title: Can this experiment produce useful evidence without escaping its safety envelope?
description: Choose a steady-state signal, inject a realistic fault, then change scope and duration. The model separates a falsified hypothesis from an abort condition and an uncontrolled experiment.
modelNotice: This is a deterministic training projection built from synthetic fixture values. It teaches the experiment contract; it does not predict a production system. Replace every baseline, impact, and boundary with measured workload telemetry before running a real fault.
